title: ReTerm: Recovery Training for Self-Improving Terminal Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.18484v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Terminal agents have shown strong abilities in complex coding tasks. However, they often struggle to recover from errors during long-running execution (e.g., command errors, faulty implementations), eventually leading to task failures. To this end, we present ReTerm, a self-improving terminal agent trained by learning how to recover from its own failed terminal tasks. To support its training, we construct a customized data pipeline and produce ReTerm-10K, a high-quality dataset that provides effective recovery demonstrations for SFT cold start. Furthermore, we propose ReTerm-GRPO, an online RL algorithm that forks from the agent's own failure states to generate multiple independent self-recovery attempts. By learning from whether these attempts successfully complete the task, the agent self-improves through its own recovery experience. Built on Qwen3.5-9B, our ReTerm-9B achieves 34.8% Pass@1 on Terminal-Bench 2.0, improving over the base

translated_title: ReTerm：面向自我改进终端智能体的恢复训练
translated_abstract: 终端智能体在复杂编程任务中展现出强大的能力。然而，它们在长时间运行过程中往往难以从错误中恢复（例如命令错误、有缺陷的实现），最终导致任务失败。为此，我们提出了ReTerm，一种通过学习如何从自身失败的终端任务中进行恢复而训练的自我改进终端智能体。为支持其训练，我们构建了一个定制化的数据流水线，并生成了ReTerm-10K，这是一个高质量数据集，为SFT冷启动提供了有效的恢复示范。此外，我们提出了ReTerm-GRPO，一种在线强化学习算法，它从智能体自身的失败状态分叉出多个独立的自我恢复尝试。通过学习这些尝试是否成功完成任务，智能体通过自身的恢复经验实现自我改进。基于Qwen3.5-9B构建的ReTerm-9B在Terminal-Bench 2.0上实现了34.8%的Pass@1，较基础模型有所提升。
tldr: 提出ReTerm终端智能体，通过恢复示范数据集ReTerm-10K进行SFT冷启动，并利用从自身失败状态分叉出多次恢复尝试的在线强化学习算法ReTerm-GRPO，让智能体从自身恢复经验中自我改进，在Terminal-Bench 2.0上取得34.8%的Pass@1成绩。
en_tdlr: ReTerm is a self-improving terminal agent that learns recovery from its own failed tasks via the ReTerm-10K dataset for SFT cold start and ReTerm-GRPO, an online RL algorithm that forks from failure states to generate self-recovery attempts, achieving 34.8% Pass@1 on Terminal-Bench 2.0.
